d: Watch Iruvar Full Movie Online! Iruvar is a 1997 Tamil Movie. Iruvar Tamil Movie stars Mohanlal in the lead role. Iruvar Movie also stars Prakash Raj, Aishwarya Rai, Tabu, Gouthami, Revathi and Nassar in pivotal roles. Iruvar Tamil Movie marked the debut of actress Aishwarya Rai. Iruvar Movie Songs are composed by A.R.Rahman. Iruvar was included in British Film Institute's 1000 Greatest Films of all time.
